description: Identifying ATMs which camera is inoperable with consistent deposits.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop-smurfing | WHERE account.event == "deposit" AND event.amount > 0 AND atm.camera_enabled IS NOT NULL AND atm.deposit_type == "cash" | STATS deposit_count = COUNT(), avg_amount = AVG(event.amount), std_dev_amount = STD_DEV(event.amount), unique_accounts = COUNT_DISTINCT(account.name), total_amount = SUM(event.amount) BY pos.merchant_name, pos.merchant_address, atm.camera_enabled | EVAL amount_consistency = CASE( std_dev_amount < 50, "highly_consistent", std_dev_amount < 150, "moderately_consistent", "variable") | WHERE deposit_count >= 10 | SORT atm.camera_enabled ASC, std_dev_amount ASC, unique_accounts DESC
